title: Immigration Rules Appendix Temporary Work – Religious Worker
summary: The Religious Worker route is for a person who wants to support the activities of religious institutions in the UK by conducting religious work such as working in a religious order or undertaking non-pastoral work for a religious organisation.

title: Immigration Rules Appendix T2 Minister of Religion
summary: This route is for a person who has a key leading role within their faith-based organisation in the UK, such as a minister of religion, missionary or other religious worker in a mainly pastoral role, or is a member of a religious order.
